mainEntity.name: Is full-body circuit training suitable for beginners?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, full-body circuit training can be highly suitable for beginners, provided the exercises are modified to match individual fitness levels and proper form is emphasized. A common mistake for beginners is attempting too much too soon, leading to injury or burnout. At Cave Training, our functional fitness approach means we focus on foundational movements and can scale the intensity and complexity of circuit exercises to ensure a safe and effective experience for everyone, regardless of their starting point.
